items.period: Shang period style; image is a modern redraw, with no specific inscription date supplied
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as the Shang oracle-script form of 一. The CUHK entry describes early forms as a single horizontal stroke representing the numeral one.
items.alt: Single horizontal oracle-script stroke representing 一.
items.selection_reason: Shows the simple early numeral form identified by the dictionary source and pairs clearly with the numeral attestation.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons file description; vector redraw, not artifact photograph.

items.period: Small-seal/Shuowen style; redraw uploaded in 2006, not a dated artifact
items.caption: A modern vector redraw labeled as 一 in Shuowen seal-script style; the received Shuowen entry interprets 一 cosmologically and labels 弌 as an ancient form.
items.alt: A seal-script redraw of 一 as one horizontal stroke.
items.selection_reason: Provides a useful later-script comparison while making clear that the displayed glyph is a modern rendering and not evidence by itself for a graphic transition.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons file description; vector redraw, not artifact photograph.

limitations.text: The Commons image files were not visually inspected in this research stage. Their file descriptions establish identity, script labels, provenance claims and stated reuse rights; a later pixel inspection should confirm the rendered forms.
The oracle redraw is attributed to Sinica and other character databases, but the underlying artifact and its inscription date are not specified by the image description.
